subject: NebulaOps marketplace resale routing and evidence checklist
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@nebulaops.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partners@nebulaops.com, procurement <procurement@nebulaops.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood marketplace listing & reseller SKU routing — NebulaOps connector

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. NebulaOps is excited to move our connector toward a Redwood marketplace listing and co-sell alignment. Can you confirm what artifacts you need from our side to (1) finish a seller listing, (2) enable co-sell / sell-with tagging, and (3) map resale SKUs so our resellers can transact?

High-level asks from our procurement and GTM teams:
- Timeline for technical certification and go-live
- Required evidence (metering, integration tests, security reports)
- Default SKU model for bundling (private offer vs marketplace SKU)
- Any demo-credit or pilot credit process we should follow for joint demos

I attached a short integration brief for context. Happy to jump on a call next week — please advise availability.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | NebulaOps
Attachments: nebulaops-integration-brief.pdf (1 page PDF, integration overview)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@nebulaops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jul 2029 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace listing & reseller SKU routing — NebulaOps connector

Hi Lena — great to hear and thanks for the brief. Looping in Karthik (partner integrations) and Ben (co-sell ops) so we can run the checklist in parallel.

Quick checklist to get started (we'll refine after your answers):
1) Technical evidence: integration brief + a short test tenant we can access (read-only demo account) + sample API key.
2) Metering: describe how usage maps to billing (per-token / per-embedding / request). If you have a simple CSV or spreadsheet mapping methods to metering units, attach it.
3) Security/compliance: SOC 2 summary or report + data retention policy + where logs are stored.
4) SKU & pricing: indicate if you want a marketplace SKU (public) or private offer (partner-managed). If you plan resellers, provide suggested SKU bundle names and renewal terms.
5) GTM & co-sell: joint demo cadence, pilot credits (how many credits required), and a list of target reseller partners.

Attachments: I pushed our intake template to make this easier (redwood-marketplace-intake-form.md). If you can fill that and supply the SOC2 summary and metering sheet, we can queue you for technical review.

Proposed next steps: you fill the intake form + we schedule a 45-min technical handoff with Karthik next week; Ben will scope the co-sell tag and demo credits after we see metering.

Availability: Tue/Wed afternoons PT work best for me.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Alliances Manager | Redwood Inference
redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0182
Attachments: redwood-marketplace-intake-form.md (Markdown checklist)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena@nebulaops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace listing & reseller SKU routing — NebulaOps connector

Thanks, Jasmine — a couple of technical clarifications from the integration team so Lena can prepare the intake: 

ACTION ITEMS (technical):
- Metering: we need a per-endpoint mapping. For example: /v1/generate = X tokens; /v1/embeddings = Y embeddings. If you have batch endpoints, note max batch sizes and common sequence lengths.
- Auth & tenant model: does NebulaOps issue customer-specific API keys, or do you expect Redwood to mediate a license key?
- KV cache / session semantics: does the connector preserve conversation state server-side or expect the caller to maintain KV?
- Latency profiles: rough p95 latency for 1k token generation vs 100 token generation (helps sizing).

From a listing perspective, private offer support is straightforward for resellers but public marketplace SKUs require metering parity. If you want resale routing, we'll need a reseller agreement PDF and a contact at the reseller to add to the intake.

I'll be the tech point for the handoff meeting — propose Tue 16 Jul at 10:00 PT. Lena, does that work?

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@nebulaops.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@nebulaops.com>, partners@nebulaops.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace listing & reseller SKU routing — NebulaOps connector

Thanks for the checklist and proposed times — Tue 16 Jul at 10:00 PT works for our engineering lead, we'll accept the invite. Attached are the metering spec and a SOC2 summary (redacted). Quick answers inline: 

- Metering: see attached 'nebulaops-metering-specs.xlsx' — primary model is per-request for REST endpoints; embedding calls count as one unit per vector; generation charges are token-count-based and our client lib returns token estimates.
- Auth model: NebulaOps issues per-customer API keys. For marketplace public SKU we can support an integration where Redwood mediates billing and we validate via signed tokens.
- KV/session: conversation state is optional; we support external KV (caller-managed) or server-side session storage (configurable).
- Latency: typical p95 for 100 tokens is ~120ms; for 1k tokens ~550ms on our standard tier.

Attachments: nebulaops-metering-specs.xlsx, nebulaops-soc2-summary.pdf

Next steps: we'll fill the intake form tonight and upload. Also looping procurement to confirm reseller agreement PDF (will send by 17 Jul).

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | NebulaOps
Attachments: nebulaops-metering-specs.xlsx (XLSX), nebulaops-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@nebulaops.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace listing & reseller SKU routing — NebulaOps connector

Thanks everyone — quick operational notes so we have a single timeline: 

1) Internal review: technical review window 3 business days after intake is complete (we'll schedule the meeting on Tue 16 as planned).
2) Evidence: once SOC2 summary + metering sheet + test tenant are validated, co-sell tagging and marketplace listing draft can be prepared (~5 business days).
3) Reseller routing: procurement to provide reseller agreement by 17 Jul; if provided, we can enable private-offer resale routing concurrently with listing.
4) Credits: Redwood can provide up to 2,000 demo credits for joint pilots (subject to a short SOW). I will start a DocuSign request and attach it to the HubSpot deal.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-2029-082 | DocuSign: https://docusign.com/txn/ABC123-nebulaops-listing

Please confirm when the intake form is uploaded and procurement has shared the reseller PDF. If all material is in by EOD 17 Jul, target listing publish week of 29 Jul.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachments: (DocuSign will be sent separately)
